name: Polymerase
oneLine: The protein that reads DNA and writes a matching mRNA.
howItWorks: The polymerase lands on a promoter and unzips a small patch of DNA. It slides along, building mRNA letter by letter. At the end signal it lets go.
deeper: Bacterial RNA polymerase adds dozens of letters per second. A different enzyme copies the whole DNA before the cell divides.
sizeComparison: a 7,000th the width of a hair
simplification: One shape stands in for several different real enzymes.
